title: 🇧🇧@alyssa.amor puts a smile on the people of Barbados’ face, as she s...
description: 🇧🇧@alyssa.amor puts a smile on the people of Barbados’ face, as she stands on the same stage that once featured the likes of Bill gates and other notable practitioners 🇧🇧 Alyssa-Amor Gibbons designs environmentally conscious architecture that combines a reverence for nature with a sense of human interconnectedness.🇧🇧🙌🏽 This is what TED talk had to say : “Architecture can’t ignore the realities of climate change. For time-tested solutions that perform under extreme conditions, designer Alyssa-Amor Gibbons says we should look to traditional buildings. Taking us to her home of Barbados, where the hurricane season is unforgiving and freak storms are becoming more frequent, Gibbons points to the brilliance of endemic designs that are built to work with nature — rather than against it.” Also  “Alyssa-Amor Gibbons describes herself as an “architeer,” a combination of architect and engineer with a hearty dash of green design principles mixed in. Creating buildings with energy efficiency at their core, she seeks to infuse beauty and elegance into sustainably built environments. Gibbons believes that, in our efforts to build shelter for ourselves, we should nonetheless make sure we step lightly and respectfully on the land.With a master’s degree in structural engineering and architecture, Gibbons has worked on projects throughout the Caribbean and the UK. She is a champion of net-zero building practices and virtual architectural modeling, which allows designers to drill down to the tiniest details before laying a single brick. “My passion is for delivering architecture that tells a story of consideration, environmental consciousness, energy efficiency and resilience,” she says.” ✅Our goal is to highlight and inspire our wonderful people here in Barbados🚀 We would greatly appreciate it if you liked and shared this video, you would be helping us as well as our country achieve this GOAL🇧🇧🙌🏾😄 #barbados #barbadostiktok🇧🇧🇧🇧 #barbadostiktok #barbados🇧🇧 #TEDtalk #tedtalk
